verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Side by side we stand,
awaiting God’s command
worshiping the saving King.
Living by grace
and moving on in faith;
Jesus himself will see us trough.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Meet me in heaven,
we’ll join hands together.
Meet me by the Saviour’s side.
I’ll meet you in heaven
we’ll sing songs toghther;
brothers and sisters, I’ll be there!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Soldiers all are we
to go where Jesus leads.
We’ll fight in faith
and we will over come.
Heaven is our goal
and saving ev’ry soul;
pray that we all will be there.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Meet me in heaven,
we’ll join hands together.
Meet me by the Saviour’s side.
I’ll meet you in heaven
we’ll sing songs toghther;
brothers and sisters, I’ll be there!
Praise the Lord,
we all will be there!
